items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture countdown clock briefly shows "Any Minute Now" before buffering into next fiscal quarter.

items.label: Update
items.text: Prophecy analyst confirms Antichrist list now supports tagging, sorting, and duplicate removal.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Third Temple project announces soft opening; tour includes photo wall and optional priestly-garment add‑on.

items.label: Report
items.text: Newspaper exegesis team upgrades to color printer after discovering prophecy also appears in charts.

items.label: Watch
items.text: Blood moon over parking lot prompts emergency shofar test; nearby teens rate it "mid" but ominous.

items.label: Update
items.text: "Silent Rapture" theory gains traction as church volunteers insist half the roster already vanished every Sunday.
